$comment: Ultra Security FedRAMP 20x Certification Package Overview — conformant to fedramp-certification-package-overview-schema-2026-06-24.json (FRC-CSO-PKG). Machine-readable identification package for the CSO. This is the schema-conformant CPO; the narrative CPO (metadata/publicInformation/... index) is a separate human-readable companion.

serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Ultra is an agentic security platform that secures AI agents and their tool use at runtime. A customer-deployed enforcement point sits inline — authenticating, proxying, and governing every agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool call — while Ultra Hub delivers centralized identity, policy, guardrails, and observability across the agent runtime. Together they give organizations autonomous-runtime security: real-time visibility and control over what AI agents can access and do, so agentic AI can be deployed and scaled safely.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Ultra's FedRAMP-compatible trust center — certification status, public information, public service list, Secure Configuration Guide, Ongoing Certification Report, and availability/status page. FedRAMP 20x documents are listed in the FedRAMP 20x section of the resources panel on the left side of the trust center and are viewable without a request; controlled documents are available via the document-request control.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Ultra's public Secure Configuration Guide — recommended secure defaults and administrative-account guidance for customers, including a machine-readable baseline and a settings-comparison capability.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: A-LIGN FedRAMP 20x Class B independent assessment report v3.2 (CR26) (assessed 2026-08-12; 203 of 203 rules met, 0 findings). Per-rule Assessment Process & Findings are included in the Security Decision Record per FedRAMP IVV. Included in the certification package per IVV-CSO-ICP.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Request via the document-request control in Ultra's trust center (trust.ultra.security); approved requests are granted access.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Product and security documentation — hub configuration, observability, installation, and core concepts.

contactInformation.contactName: Rob Gutierrez, Director, Security & Business Operations

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: The FedRAMP-assessed cloud service offering: the Ultra Hub control plane (org/team/workspace management, identities, governance, guardrails, and telemetry) and its AWS-hosted data stores. This is the Minimum Assessment Scope, categorized Low (FedRAMP 20x Class B baseline). The product also includes a customer-deployed enforcement point that runs client-side in the customer's environment; per FedRAMP guidance a customer-deployed/hosted component is always outside the assessment scope and is not part of this certified service (where an agency deploys it, it is covered under that agency's ATO).

nonCertified.name: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
nonCertified.useCase: Underlying IaaS — compute (ECS/Fargate), database (Aurora), load balancing, KMS, and CloudTrail logging; primary region us-east-1 (also us-west-2, eu-west-1). Mitigations: least-privilege security groups, KMS encryption at rest, TLS in transit, CloudTrail logging.

nonCertified.name: Google Workspace
nonCertified.useCase: Corporate email and productivity (FedRAMP High authorized); limited handling of federal customer communications.
